PHASE 2: MANUAL CODE REVIEW EVIDENCE
================================================================================

--- TokoinFixedSupply.sol (27 lines) ---

Line 10: uint8 private constant TOKOIN_DECIMALS = 8;
  -> Fixed at compile time. No setter. CONFIRMED.

Line 11: uint256 public constant TOTAL_SUPPLY_ACEROS = 100000000000000;
  -> 100T aceros = 1M TOKOIN. No setter. CONFIRMED.

Line 12: address public immutable genesisTreasury;
  -> Set once in constructor. Immutable. CONFIRMED.

Line 16-22: constructor mints entire supply to genesisTreasury.
  -> No post-constructor mint path exists. CONFIRMED.

Lines 24-26: decimals() returns TOKOIN_DECIMALS (8).
  -> Pure function, no state dependency. CONFIRMED.

No additional functions beyond ERC-20 standard.

--- TokoinResearchRewards.sol (122 lines) ---

Line 22: IERC20 public immutable tokoin;
Line 23: address public immutable settlementAuthority;
  -> Both set once in constructor. No setters. CONFIRMED.

Line 59-62: claimLeaf() includes block.chainid, address(this), challengeId, account, amount, role.
  -> Double keccak256 (OZ standard leaf). Domain separation CONFIRMED.

Line 78: if (msg.sender != settlementAuthority) revert AuthorityOnly();
  -> Authority-only enforcement. CONFIRMED.

Line 80-82: if (settlements[challengeId].payoutRoot != bytes32(0)) revert SettlementAlreadyPublished();
  -> Settlement immutability. CONFIRMED.

Line 83-86: Balance validation before reservation.
  -> Checks reservedAmount vs balance, prevents over-commitment. CONFIRMED.

Line 93: reservedAmount += totalAmount;
  -> Reservation tracking. CONFIRMED.

Line 107: if (claims[claimId]) revert AlreadyClaimed();
  -> Double-claim prevention. CONFIRMED.

Line 109-111: MerkleProof.verifyCalldata(proof, settlement.payoutRoot, claimId)
  -> OpenZeppelin MerkleProof validation. CONFIRMED.

Lines 116-119: State changes (claims, claimedAmount, reservedAmount) BEFORE safeTransfer.
  -> CEI pattern. No reentrancy. CONFIRMED.

--- AgoraAgentIdentity.sol (80 lines) ---

Line 19: address public immutable issuer;
  -> Set once. No setter. CONFIRMED.

Line 39: if (msg.sender != issuer) revert IssuerOnly();
  -> Issuer-only minting. CONFIRMED.

Line 40-41: identityMinted[agentIdentityHash] check.
  -> Uniqueness enforcement. CONFIRMED.

Line 42: tokenId = uint256(agentIdentityHash);
  -> Deterministic ID. CONFIRMED.

Line 44: _safeMint(to, tokenId);
  -> Uses safeMint (ERC-721 receiver check). CONFIRMED.

Lines 60-66: approve and setApprovalForAll both revert Soulbound.
  -> Transfer approval blocked. CONFIRMED.

Lines 68-75: _update override.
  -> if (_ownerOf(tokenId) != address(0)) revert Soulbound();
  -> Only allows initial mint (from address(0)). All transfers blocked. CONFIRMED.

Lines 77-79: supportsInterface includes IERC5192.
  -> ERC-5192 compliance. CONFIRMED.
